name: Painter Morag

intro.text: You know the saying? 'Like painting the Forth Bridge.' Never finished. Well, I finished. 2011. Twenty-five years of guarantee. So now I have time on my hands, and a lot of red paint, and you.

win: Fair enough. Mind, you've got a bit of red on your sleeve. That's tradition.
after: Two hundred and forty thousand litres of paint, near enough, to do the whole bridge. I counted the tins. Somebody had to.
